requirements.title: Risks unique to or exacerbated by generative AI

notes: This data version holds the twelve risks of section 2, each read as the outcome that the risk is identified and managed for the system. The suggested actions of section 3 (for example GV-1.1-001) are not included yet; a later data version may add them as new requirements. The profile is voluntary; a covered cell is never a statement of conformity.
